snippet.title: Backlog Dungeon Trailer
snippet.description:
Backlog Dungeon is an asynchronous co-op dungeon crawler on Infinite Backlog, where your real-life gaming activity powers your party's actions. Team up with your guild to deal damage, protect your allies, and work together to overcome the monsters and challenges ahead.

Create or join a guild on Infinite Backlog and start playing on November 9th!
